cues.text: In 1615 Edo Japan, a masterless samurai was ambushed by fifty shadow assassins in a misty bamboo forest.
He didn't draw his katana. He closed his eyes and whispered: The blade is drawn only when death is accepted.
In three seconds of blinding steel, every lantern shattered. When the mist cleared, only one sword remained standing.
Honor is eternal. Would you survive this duel? Drop your answer below.
